description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 较早的 Windows 10 上：1809 到 1909 录屏不再一开始就失败；截图直接用老办法截；2004 之前排除自己窗口不再变黑；深色标题栏生效。权限不变。
notes.en: On older Windows 10: recording no longer fails at once on 1809 to 1909; screenshots go straight to the older capture method; before 2004, leaving out WinShun's own windows no longer turns them black; dark title bars work. Permissions unchanged.
